summary: Retest of the ONE critical bug from iteration_131 (calendar->training workout-resolution fallback for demo/catalog-plan accounts). Fix VERIFIED WORKING end-to-end. Frontend-only testing performed via Playwright against the live preview URL (https://scenic-trainer.preview.emergentagent.com). All 5 requested scenarios pass: (1) demo@roujaune.app tapping FRI 'Recovery Ride' and SAT 'Sweet Spot' calendar cards each correctly rendered THAT day's title/duration/zone/tss on Today's Training (not 'Threshold Climb'); (2) Start Workout from the Sweet Spot screen correctly launched the live /workout screen also showing 'Sweet Spot' (SESSION · Sweet Spot header, correct segment plan); (3) greenlantern@roujaune.app regression: tapping THU 'Pedal Smoothly' (ctr-ride-2) correctly showed Pedal Smoothly on both /training and live /workout — no regression; (4) Today's-own-day card on both accounts (demo WED 'Endurance Ride', greenlantern TUE 'Welcome Ride') still resolves correctly; (5) Rest-day sanity check on demo (TUE 'Rest Day') and greenlantern ('Complete Rest') — tapping stayed on /calendar (day just selected, no navigation), unchanged from before.

ui_bugs.issue: Minor/cosmetic: on greenlantern's structured plan, the TRAINING row card's testID renders as literal 'training-undefined' for all 4 sessions (id attribute passed to testID template is undefined) instead of a unique id like 'training-c1'. Does not affect functionality (workoutId in the URL params is correctly populated with the real catalog id e.g. ctr-ride-2) — purely a testability/debugging gap, not a functional bug.

action_items: LOW PRIORITY (optional): fix the DraggableSession/TrainingSessionCard testID generation for greenlantern-style structured plan sessions so it uses a stable unique id (e.g. `training-${d.cycling.id ?? d.cycling.workout_id ?? d.date}`) instead of rendering literally 'training-undefined' for every day — purely a test-tooling improvement, no user-facing impact.
critical_code_review_comments: calendar.tsx goToWorkout(): `const wid = s.workout_id || s.id || "";` correctly falls back to the bare `id` field when workout_id is absent — verified this produces workoutId=c1..c7 for the demo catalog plan and never sends an empty string anymore.

training.tsx: `const paramId = typeof params.workoutId === "string" && params.workoutId.length > 0 ? params.workoutId : undefined;` correctly requires non-empty length (not just truthiness), and `meta` correctly prioritizes `params.title` whenever `paramId` is present, before falling back to `activePlanRide` lookup — verified this is what fixed the bug (each tapped day now shows its own distinct title/duration/zone instead of always 'Threshold Climb').

workout.tsx: same `hasWorkoutId = typeof params.workoutId === "string" && params.workoutId.length > 0` guard applied to the live-ride resolution path — verified the live workout screen also reflects the correct tapped-day workout, not a hardcoded demo default.

success_rate.backend: not tested this pass (out of scope per review request — backend already 24/24 in iteration_131)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 requested scenarios pass on both demo@roujaune.app and greenlantern@roujaune.app)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded demo/greenlantern accounts only, no data created or mutated beyond normal navigation (no workouts were completed/started to persistence).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The iteration_131 critical bug (calendar tap -> Today's Training showing wrong/hardcoded 'Threshold Climb' for demo/catalog-plan accounts) is CONFIRMED FIXED. Verified with 2 distinct non-today days (Recovery Ride, Sweet Spot) on demo@roujaune.app, plus the full Start Workout -> live /workout chain, plus regression on greenlantern@roujaune.app (Pedal Smoothly, ctr-ride-2), plus today's-own-day and rest-day sanity checks on both accounts. No further action needed on this specific flow. Only remaining note is a cosmetic testID gap ('training-undefined') on greenlantern's structured-plan training cards — non-blocking, optional cleanup only.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this pass is a verification-only retest confirming the previously-identified RCA (empty-string workoutId falsy-coalescing in training.tsx/calendar.tsx) has been correctly fixed per the described code changes in calendar.tsx, training.tsx, and workout.tsx.
